statements.quote: The investments we are making in cloud and AI infrastructure and devices will continue to increase our operating costs and may decrease our operating margins.
statements.notes: Forward-looking statement that AI infrastructure investment will raise operating costs. No year is named, so code applies the year after the reported year (2026). Wording is close to risk-factor language but appears in MD&A.

statements.quote: Operating expenses increased $3.8 billion or 6% driven by investments in cloud and AI engineering and Gaming, including the impact of the Activision Blizzard acquisition.
statements.notes: The $3.8 billion is the year-over-year increase in total operating expenses, not a level of total or AI opex, so it is recorded as qualitative to avoid misreading it as a total. AI is one of several named drivers. No year is named, so code applies the reported year (2025). Likely company-wide, but the passage does not confirm this.

statements.quote: Operating expenses increased $1.1 billion or 4% driven by investments in cloud and AI engineering and commercial sales.
statements.notes: Segment-level bullet; the passage does not name the segment. The $1.1 billion is an increase, not a level. AI is one of several named drivers.

statements.quote: Operating expenses increased $1.5 billion or 7% driven by investments in cloud and AI engineering.
statements.notes: Segment-level bullet; the passage does not name the segment. The $1.5 billion is an increase, not a level. AI is attributed jointly with cloud.

statements.quote: Research and development expenses increased $3.0 billion or 10% driven by investments in cloud and AI engineering and Gaming, including the impact of the Activision Blizzard acquisition.
statements.notes: R&D opex line. The $3.0 billion is the year-over-year increase, not a level of total or AI R&D. AI is one of several named drivers.

statements.quote: We will continue to invest in capital expenditures to support growth in our cloud offerings and our investments in AI infrastructure and training.
statements.notes: Gives no amount; capital expenditures are linked to AI infrastructure and training in words only. No year is named, so code applies the year after the reported year (2026).
